incidents.body:
We have released an update that resolves the issues affecting the Autopilot Journeys email editor and intermittent loading behavior. Resources have been reallocated, and performance has stabilized.

All functionality is now operating normally. We will continue to monitor closely to ensure continued stability. Thank you for your patience.
